name: Izipreyi zomlilo
intro: Izinhloko ezisohlwini ngokwezigaba zengozi, ipayipi elizondlayo, kanye nokubalwa kwamandla amanzi. Imibandela yokuklama ithebula lakho; okuzenzakalelayo kuhlose ukubuyekezwa ngochwepheshe. Isisiza sokuklama, hhayi ukuvunyelwa.
